open_points.subject: A1 subfolder traversal
open_points.text: When the photo folder, or a subfolder that is not ignored, cannot be opened or listed, the whole operation is refused with `folder_unavailable`, so a partial scan is never reported as complete. / A subfolder the listing showed is opened without following a link: when the opening finds a symbolic link, dangling or not, or an object that is not a folder, it is not entered and the scan goes on
open_points.question: When a listed subfolder is replaced before opening by a symbolic link or non-folder, must the entire scan be refused or must that entry be skipped while the scan continues?
options: Refuse the whole scan with `folder_unavailable` because the subfolder cannot be opened as a folder.
Skip the replaced entry and complete the rest of the scan.
open_points.default_guess: Apply the more specific later rule: skip a symbolic link or non-folder, but refuse disappearance and other opening failures.

witness.initial: The opened photo folder contains a non-ignored subfolder named `day`, and the listing reports it as a directory.
events: The deliverer lists the photo folder.
Syncthing replaces `day` with a symbolic link or regular file.
The deliverer opens `day` without following links.
outcomes: The broad rule refuses the whole scan with `folder_unavailable`.
The specific traversal rule skips `day` and returns a complete scan of the remaining entries.
witness.observer: The calling flow and owner see refusal versus a completed scan.

open_points.subject: A2 resized dimensions
open_points.text: the other side keeps the proportion, rounded to whole pixels
open_points.question: Which rounding rule, including the exact-half case and the minimum permitted dimension, determines the other side?
options: Round to nearest with halves upward and clamp the result to at least one pixel.
Round to nearest with ties to even and clamp to at least one pixel.
open_points.default_guess: Round to nearest with halves upward and clamp to at least one pixel.

witness.initial: A valid source is 4000 by 2001 pixels, has no orientation change, and the longest-side limit is 2000 pixels.
events: The deliverer scales the longest side from 4000 to 2000, making the proportional other side exactly 1000.5 pixels.
outcomes: One implementation stores a 2000 by 1000 JPEG.
Another implementation stores a 2000 by 1001 JPEG.
witness.observer: The Portal and client see different image dimensions, pixels, hashes and sizes.

open_points.subject: A2 alpha-aware Lanczos reduction
open_points.text: the image is reduced with a Lanczos filter so that its longest side equals the limit and the other side keeps the proportion, rounded to whole pixels; then transparent and partly transparent pixels are composited onto white by their alpha
open_points.question: Must resizing interpolate straight colour channels and alpha independently, or premultiply colour by alpha before Lanczos interpolation; and what Lanczos support, edge handling and channel quantisation are required?
options: Resize straight RGBA channels, then composite the resulting straight colour and alpha onto white.
Premultiply RGB by alpha, resize premultiplied RGB and alpha, then composite/unpremultiply as required.
Leave all numerical details to the selected image library.
open_points.default_guess: Use a fixed Lanczos-3 kernel in decoded sample space with premultiplied alpha, defined edge clamping and deterministic channel rounding.

witness.initial: A valid oversized RGBA image has an opaque dark pixel region adjacent to fully transparent pixels whose stored RGB values are bright.
events: The deliverer reduces the image with Lanczos and then composites it onto white.
outcomes: Straight-channel interpolation lets the hidden bright RGB values create a bright fringe.
Premultiplied-alpha interpolation prevents hidden RGB values from affecting the visible fringe.
witness.observer: The Portal client sees different edge colours; the stored hash and size also differ.

open_points.subject: A6 temporary-file allocation
open_points.text: A temporary file left by a crash stays under its temporary name beginning with `.tmp-`; it is never read and the service does not remove it.
open_points.question: How is a temporary name chosen, and what must a later write do when an abandoned temporary file already occupies the chosen name?
options: Generate a collision-resistant fresh name and retry collisions until creation succeeds.
Use a deterministic name and replace or truncate an abandoned temporary file.
Use exclusive creation and fail the operation on a collision.
open_points.default_guess: Create a collision-resistant unique name exclusively and retry with a new name on collision.

witness.initial: A crash has left `.tmp-fixed` in the destination folder, and no placement record exists.
events: The deliverer selects a temporary name for the new stored image.
outcomes: An implementation choosing a fresh unique name completes the placement.
An implementation reusing `.tmp-fixed` with exclusive creation treats the collision as a write failure and returns `UNREADABLE_FILE`.
witness.observer: The calling flow and owner see a successful placement versus a failed delivery.

open_points.subject: A5 token trimming policy
open_points.text:
the ASCII whitespace at both ends (space, tab, line feed, carriage return,
   vertical tab and form feed) is removed; no other character is removed.
open_points.rule: Таблица выше — исчерпывающий список путей значения, и у каждого из них своя форма: перечисление называется адресом, константа поставщика — `the imported X constant`, настройка — полем объекта настроек.
open_points.question: Replace the inline closed set of trimmed characters with the name of an imported provider constant that contains that set.

open_points.subject: A6 lock-file mode
open_points.text:
The lock file is created on
   first use with mode 0600 and never removed; it holds no content.
open_points.rule: У значения, которое читает генерируемый код, ровно три пути; путь выбирается по тому, что это за значение, и у значения один дом (§15.4).
open_points.question: Name mode 0600 through an imported provider constant, rather than leaving the generated code to embed this policy value directly.

open_points.subject: A6 temporary-file prefix
open_points.text:
A temporary file
   left by a crash stays under its temporary name beginning with `.tmp-`; it is never read and the
   service does not remove it.
open_points.rule: Таблица выше — исчерпывающий список путей значения, и у каждого из них своя форма: перечисление называется адресом, константа поставщика — `the imported X constant`, настройка — полем объекта настроек.
open_points.question: Replace the inline `.tmp-` policy prefix with the name of an imported provider constant.
